sections.shortTitle: Balochistan Historical Mosques and Shrines Cess Fund Amendment Act 2011
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT IX OF 2011
ACT IX OF 2011
BALOCHISTAN HISTORICAL MOSQUES AND SHRINES CESS FUND (AMENDMENT)
ACT, 2011
An Act further to attend the
Balochistan Historical Mosques and
Shrines Cess Fund Ordinance, 1960
(W. P. Ordinance V of 1960).
[Gazette of Balochistan, Extraordinary, 24th August, 2011]
No. PAB/Legis: V
(00)/2011, dated 24-8-2011.---The Balochistan Historical Mosques and Shrines
Cess Fund (Amendment) Bill No. IX of 2011, having been passed by the Provincial
Assembly of Balochistan on 16th August, 2011 and assented to by the Governor,
Balochistan on 24th August, 2011 is hereby published as an Act of the
Balochistan Provincial Assembly.
Preamble.---Whereas, it is expedient further to amend the
Balochistan Historical Mosques and Shrines Cess Fund Ordinance, 1960 (W.P.
Ordinance V of 1960), in the manner hereinafter appearing:
It is hereby
enacted as follows:--
1. Short title
and commencement.---(1) This Act
may be called the Balochistan Historical Mosques and Shrines Cess Fund,
(Amendment) Act, 2011.
(2) It extends to
the whole of Balochistan except the Tribal Areas.
(3) It shall come
into force at once.
